title: Shape of Dreams Brings Fast-Paced Roguelite Action to Players
summary: Shape of Dreams, the action roguelite from Lizard Smoothie and NEOWIZ, combines fast top-down combat, build experimentation, and cooperative play for up to four players.
content:
Shape of Dreams has officially launched, bringing a fast-paced top-down roguelite experience built around intense combat and flexible character builds.

Developed by Lizard Smoothie and published by NEOWIZ, the game combines roguelite progression with action-focused combat. Players can experiment with different abilities and builds while fighting through chaotic encounters.

The game can be played solo or cooperatively with up to three other players. This gives players the option to approach its challenges alone or build a team around complementary abilities.

A major part of the experience is build experimentation. Players can combine different powers and adapt their setup as they progress, creating different approaches to combat from one run to another.

Shape of Dreams is now available on PC through Steam, giving players a chance to explore its colorful fantasy world and fast-paced combat system.

faq.question: What is Shape of Dreams?
faq.answer: Shape of Dreams is a top-down action roguelite developed by Lizard Smoothie and published by NEOWIZ.

faq.question: When was Shape of Dreams released?
faq.answer: Shape of Dreams was released on September 10, 2025.

faq.question: Can Shape of Dreams be played cooperatively?
faq.answer: Yes. The game supports solo play and cooperative play with up to four players.

faq.question: What is the main gameplay focus?
faq.answer: The game focuses on fast combat, roguelite progression, and experimenting with different character builds.
